headline: LNG Carrier Explodes After Hitting Mine in Strait of Hormuz
summary: An LNG carrier caught fire and exploded after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz while attempting to use an unauthorized transit route.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical global chokepoint for liquefied natural gas and oil transit, making maritime security incidents vital for energy markets.

impacts.name: Natural Gas
impacts.why: Disruptions or security incidents involving LNG transport through key chokepoints threaten energy supply flows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An explosion on an LNG carrier in a vital shipping lane renews concerns over energy transit security.
